sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 488 physical subject rows / 458 family-card identities and 17 sections are reconciled, including 268 literal Rookie marks. Original Name/Team/Rookie cells, repeated dual/booklet signers, historical team assignments, Portland Trailblazers and Persistant Marks wording remain intact. All 91 Hobby/FDI odds retain original literals and nulls with unstated ratio units. Ten exact guide specifications include nine odds joins; Holo Gold /50 remains separate from Gold Electricity. Base Inception is a qualified one-copy print limit, not inferred serial marking. Cedric Coward DG-CC Blue /25 stays card-specific. Store July 23 availability and guide/interview publication do not establish an explicit general release date; other numbering and exhaustive parallel coverage remain unverified.
Exhaustive parallel numbering remains unverified. The guide describes seven base parallels, while the odds include additional Green and Sky Blue categories; no missing limits are inferred.
Guide Holo Gold /50 is retained under its exact name without an odds join to the separately named Base Gold Electricity category.
The base Inception sentence publishes a one-copy limit without explicitly stating serial marking; no serial number is assigned to Base Inception from that sentence.
Cedric Coward DG-CC Blue /25 is card-specific; other Dawn subjects and colors remain unnumbered.
Interview first-milestone 5-and-1 statements have no exact parallel joins; no Sky Blue or Inception limits are inferred from those guest remarks.
The Hobby/FDI odds header does not state ratio units. Store July 23 availability, guide/interview publication and release-day wording remain separate from an explicit general calendar release date.
